name: file-type
title: File Type
description: Colored file-type badges above a list of recent documents with names, sizes and authors.
use: Document lists that need clear file type icons.
usage:
import { FileType, getFileType, type FileTypeName } from "./file-type" const formats = [ "pdf", "docx", "xlsx", "pptx", "jpg", "mp4", "mp3", "zip", "fig", "html", ] as const satisfies readonly FileTypeName[] const recent = [ { name: "Q3 board deck.pptx", size: "18.4 MB", edited: "Edited 2h ago by Maya Chen" }, { name: "Series A term sheet.pdf", size: "412 KB", edited: "Edited yesterday by Daniel Ortiz" }, { name: "Revenue model 2026.xlsx", size: "2.1 MB", edited: "Edited Mon by Priya Raman" }, { name: "Launch teaser.mp4", size: "64.7 MB", edited: "Uploaded Sep 12 by Leo Park" }, ] export default function FileTypeDemo() { return (
{formats.map((type, i) => ( ))}
    {recent.map((file) => (

  • {file.name}

    {file.edited}

    {file.size}
    • ))}
) }
